connector.name: Fortress
connector.registryDescription: Stealth browser for AI agents: fetch pages behind Cloudflare/DataDome/CAPTCHA, extract clean data.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package tilion. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tiliondev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: TILION_MCP_PREWARM
env.description: Boot the browser at startup so the first tool call is instant (default 1).

env.name: TILION_MCP_HEADLESS
env.description: Set 0 to show a visible browser window (default 1).

env.name: TILION_ALLOW_PRIVATE_EGRESS
env.description: Set 1 to allow tools to reach localhost / private IPs (SSRF guard off).

env.name: TILION_BASE_URL
env.description: Run browsers on a hosted Tilion server instead of locally.

env.name: TILION_API_KEY
env.description: Bearer key for the hosted Tilion server (cloud mode only).
